# Ordinance No. 011, Series of 2018 — Use of Savings for Augmentation

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the [[Municipal Mayor]] and/or the Presiding Officer of the [[Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo]] to use savings for the augmentation of budget items in accordance with [[Sec-336-RA7160]] (Use of Appropriated Funds and Savings) of the [[Local Government Code of 1991]]. The ordinance defines "savings" as portions or balances of any programmed appropriation in the approved budget of the LGU that are free from any obligation or encumbrance. It further defines "augmentation" as the existence in the budget of an item, project, or activity with an appropriation which is determined to be deficient.

## Key Provisions

- Authorizes the Municipal Mayor and/or the Presiding Officer to use savings for augmentation of deficient budget items.
- Defines "savings" as portions or balances of programmed appropriations free from obligation or encumbrance.
- Defines "augmentation" as an existing budget item determined to be deficient.
- Operates in accordance with [[Sec-336-RA7160]] on the use of appropriated funds and savings.
